name: Quivver → BTB Transition — v1 Test (Structural Interlock)
description: Testing longer coexistence. Quivver's melody ends at ~226, leaving a kick/bass loop through 248 (sharp dropout). BTB bars 0-16 are pure kick drum in 1A (matching Quivver). Overlap 20 bars: Quivver 236-256 with BTB 0-20. BTB enters 4A at bar 17, but Quivver has no melody by then — only dying kicks/bass. Automation hands off smoothly at the kick dropout.

tracks.name: Quivver — Brothers & Sisters (Original Mix)
tracks.notes: LUFS -14.2. Extended cue_out from 226 to 256 to include the kick/bass outro loop. Melody ends ~226, kicks die at 248, silence by 256.

tracks.name: Below The Belt (Chris Micali Remix)
tracks.notes: LUFS -13.9. cue_in at 0 (was 17 in 1b). Bars 0-16 are pure kick in 1A, bar 17+ enters 4A.

transitions.notes: v1 test: 20-bar overlap. Quivver bars 236-256 meets BTB bars 0-20. Bars 0-16 of BTB are pure kick in 1A (safe zone). Quivver kicks die at overlap bar ~12 (= Quivver bar 248). Automation crosses over at bar 12-14 to match the natural energy handoff. BTB enters 4A at overlap bar ~17 but by then Quivver is essentially gone (broadband -15 to -19 dB).
